sugar-creek-baptist-sugar-land.assessment: Sugar Creek Baptist Church is a large multi-campus SBC church in the Houston metro area led by Dr. Mark Hartman since 2002. Doctrinally, the church affirms Trinitarian theology, the Bible as 'true and fully accurate,' and salvation as a free gift through faith in Christ — all solid positions. The church appears complementarian in practice (pastoral titles for men, support roles for women) though not explicitly stated. Three campuses with multiple service styles including traditional, contemporary, and Spanish-language. Major concern: no dedicated men's ministry despite being a large church with 100+ staff. The church emphasizes community through Connect Groups and has strong mission language. SBC affiliation provides denominational accountability. Needs in-person evaluation to verify preaching style and cultural alignment.

score_notes.christology: Affirms Jesus as central — 'it all starts with Jesus.' Salvation through Christ's death and resurrection. Trinitarian: God 'exists eternally in three persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit' (Matthew 28:19).
score_notes.scripture: Describes Bible as 'God's Word, a true and fully accurate account.' While not using the explicit term 'inerrancy,' the language of 'true and fully accurate' is functionally equivalent. SBC affiliation aligns with Baptist Faith & Message which affirms inerrancy.
score_notes.gender: Male lead pastor (Dr. Mark Hartman). Women serve in support roles: Women's Ministry Associates, Children's Ministry Directors, Preschool Ministry Director. Pastoral and 'Associate Pastor' titles appear reserved for men. Women hold 'Minister' and 'Director' titles in children's and women's areas. Appears complementarian in practice but not explicitly stated.
score_notes.leadership: Lead Pastor Mark Hartman; SBC polity with pastoral team and 'Meet Our Team' staff page — plural pastoral leadership standard for SBC.
score_notes.soteriology: Clear faith-alone presentation: Jesus 'offers a restored relationship with God as a free gift to all who believe.' Believer's baptism by immersion as 'first public act of confession' — not salvific. Sound soteriology.
score_notes.cultural: Describes itself as 'diverse and vibrant community.' Spanish-language ministry. No explicit DEI/CRT language detected, but 'diverse' emphasis needs in-person verification to determine if diversity is organic or ideologically driven.
score_notes.preaching: SBC-typical preaching; style not explicitly labeled 'expository' on About page — assumed biblical teaching per BF&M adherence.
score_notes.mission: Strong global missions focus — founded Living Water International after 1990 Africa trip.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: No dedicated men's ministry found. Singles groups exist for 'men and women' together but no men-only discipleship. Red for lack of intentional male formation.
score_notes.denominational: Explicitly 'Southern Baptist Church and aligned with the Baptist Faith and Message.'
